description.text: A high-class pack released on 20 November 2020 that gathered cards that did well at events and other strong cards of the series, many in new illustrations, and added 127 kinds of shiny Pokémon, the most yet. Each pack held ten cards, one of them a Pokémon V or VMAX. New cards included Ditto V and VMAX, Crobat VMAX, and Amazing Rare Reshiram, Kyogre and Yveltal, and the ordinary cards also came in mirror holo versions. The cards are numbered to 190, followed by full-art Super Rare Supporters such as Marnie and Piers, 104 shiny Pokémon marked S, 23 shiny Pokémon V and VMAX marked SSR, and Ultra Rare Eternatus V and VMAX, Zacian V and Zamazenta V. In English some of its shiny cards came out in Shining Fates in February 2021.
